name: Stripe Billing
summary: Stripe Billing charges 0.7% of billing volume on pay-as-you-go, or a monthly fee on a one-year contract from $620 for up to $100,000 of monthly volume. Card processing is charged separately at 2.9% plus 30 cents in the US, and the business stays the seller of record.

facts.text: Smart Retries recommends 8 tries within 2 weeks by default, and Stripe emails the customer after each failed payment.
Stripe exports saved card data only to another PCI DSS Level 1 processor, and it does not export subscriptions or payment history.
Stripe Tax is a separate paid product, at 0.5% per transaction where the business is registered on its no-code option.
Stripe Managed Payments, a separate product in which Stripe is merchant of record, adds 3.5% per transaction to payment fees.
Stripe completed its acquisition of Metronome, now its main usage-based billing platform, in January 2026.
Monthly-fee plans cannot be downgraded during the contract term, and fees are not refunded on early cancellation.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.notes: No recurring fee. Covers billing on and off Stripe, excluding one-off invoices

plans.name: Up to $100,000 a month
plans.notes: 1-year contract; 0.67% on volume above the tier

hiddenCosts: Card processing is extra: 2.9% plus 30 cents per US card charge, 1.5% more for international cards and 1% for currency conversion.
A custom domain for the customer portal costs $10 a month.

contract.cancellation: Monthly-fee plans renew automatically, cancellation takes effect at the end of the term, and fees are not refunded.
contract.dataExport: Data through the API or Dashboard; saved cards only to another PCI DSS Level 1 processor.
